descriptions.zh:
**请确保在使用该接口前，已充分了解 PDS 的收费方式和[价格](~~425220~~)**。

使用此功能须开通增值服务图片处理功能。

用户在创建故事后，可以根据需求移除故事中不需要的文件。
descriptions.en:
**Before calling this operation, ensure you understand PDS billing and review its [Pricing](~~425220~~).**

To use this feature, you must enable the image processing value-added service.

After you create a story, you can remove unwanted files from it as needed.
